prompt: CI has started failing on this reminder service roughly one run in five, and the failing test changes from run to run. The same suite is green on my machine. Please make the suite reliable so a failure means the product or its test really broke. Keep every current test and every assertion. Do not skip or mark tests, add retries, loosen expected values, or hide errors. Add focused regression coverage where it belongs and keep the visible checks runnable from the repository root with `node --test --test-timeout=5000 test/*.test.js`. Put test files under `test/` and keep them as `.test.js` CommonJS files. The project targets Node.js 24 and has no dependency install step. Preserve the documented reminder behavior, the small API, the outbox contract, and the existing package scripts. Keep temporary data isolated and clean up anything created by tests. Do not make unrelated production or documentation changes.

rubric.criterion: The added coverage is clear enough for the next teammate to maintain (code cannot check this because clarity and maintenance quality require human review).
